<!-- Generated by web/docs/tools/generate-sdk-reference.py. Do not edit. -->

This reference lists the public Python SDK interfaces, including signatures, resource helpers, and model types, so you can look up how to call the SDK and interpret its results.
Start with [Getting started with the SDK](/sdk/); see [Errors and recovery](/sdk/errors/) for connection lifetime, deadlines, and retries.

## Hypervisor

```python
class Hypervisor(Client):
    connections: Connections
    credentials: Credentials
    debug: Debug
    images: Images
    mcp: Mcp
    networks: Networks
    def __init__(self, url: str, token: str, *, timeout: float=30) -> None:
        ...
    async def info(self) -> models.HypervisorInfo:
        ...
    async def list(self) -> models.ListResponse:
        ...
    def vm(self, *, name: str | None=None, id: str | None=None) -> VM:
        "A handle for an existing VM on this hypervisor's transport, selected by\nexactly one nonempty name or id."
        ...
    async def create(self, *, name: str='', cpus: int | None=None, memory: int | None=None, env: dict[str, str] | None=None, networks: Sequence[models.NetworkInfo]=(), image: str | None=None, command: Sequence[str]=(), registry: Registry | None=None) -> VM:
        ...
    def managed(self, *, cpus: int | None=None, memory: int | None=None, env: dict[str, str] | None=None, networks: Sequence[models.NetworkInfo]=(), image: str | None=None, command: Sequence[str]=(), registry: Registry | None=None) -> ManagedSession:
        'An ephemeral ownership scope: renew while entered, await cleanup on exit.'
        ...
    async def log(self, source: models.HostLogSource=models.HostLogSource.SERVICE, *, grep: str | None=None, tail: int | None=None, max_bytes: int | None=None) -> models.HostLogsResponse:
        ...
    async def run(self, command: str, *, timeout_secs: int | None=None, cpus: int | None=None, memory: int | None=None, env: dict[str, str] | None=None) -> ExecResult:
        ...
    async def purge(self, *, all: bool=False) -> models.PurgeResponse:
        ...
    async def update(self) -> models.UpdateActionResponse:
        ...
    async def restart(self) -> models.RestartResponse:
        'Restart an idle managed service; reconnect with a new gateway token.'
        ...
```

## VM

```python
class VM(Client):
    container: Container
    credential_grants: CredentialGrants
    files: Files
    networks: VmNetworks
    ports: Ports

    def __init__(self, url: str, token: str, *, name: str | None=None, id: str | None=None, timeout: float=30) -> None:
        ...
    @property
    def id(self) -> str | None:
        'Canonical ID, populated by the first request when selecting by name.'
        ...
    @property
    def name(self) -> str | None:
        ...
    async def info(self) -> models.SandboxInfo:
        ...
    async def exec(self, command: str, *, timeout_secs: int | None=None, target: models.ExecTarget | None=None) -> ExecResult:
        ...
    async def start(self) -> models.ProvisionResponse:
        ...
    async def persist(self, name: str) -> models.PersistResponse:
        ...
    async def stop(self) -> models.StopResponse:
        ...
    async def pause(self) -> models.VmActionResponse:
        ...
    async def resume(self) -> models.ProvisionResponse:
        ...
    async def delete(self) -> models.VmActionResponse:
        ...
    async def fork(self, name: str, *, description: str | None=None) -> VM:
        ...
    async def log(self, *, grep: str | None=None, tail: int | None=None, max_bytes: int | None=None) -> models.LogsResponse:
        ...
    async def history(self, *, limit: int | None=None, offset: int | None=None, search: str | None=None, layer: models.HistoryLayerFilter | None=None) -> models.HistoryResponse:
        ...
    async def timeline(self, *, trace_id: str | None=None, since: str | None=None, limit: int | None=None, layers: Sequence[models.TimelineLayer] | None=None) -> models.TimelineResponse:
```

## ManagedSession

```python
class ManagedSession():
    'Use ``async with hv.managed(...) as vm`` for an owned ephemeral VM.\n\nOne create is issued. Connection loss, cancellation and close never replay\nit. A client crash stops renewal; the service owns finite lease expiry.'
    def __init__(self, transport: Transport, request: models.ProvisionRequest) -> None:
        ...
    @property
    def ownership(self) -> models.ManagedSessionOwnership | None:
        'Verified nonsecret metadata; the capability is never exposed here.'
        ...
    async def __aenter__(self) -> VM:
        ...
    async def __aexit__(self, _kind: type[BaseException] | None, error: BaseException | None, _traceback: TracebackType | None) -> None:
        ...
    async def close(self, outcome: models.ManagedSessionOutcome=models.ManagedSessionOutcome.COMPLETED) -> None:
        'Join cleanup, including repeated cancellation; a failed close may be retried explicitly.'
        ...
```

```python
class ExecResult(ExecResponse):
```

```python
class Connections():

    def __init__(self, transport: Transport) -> None:

        'The caller retains the request ID, opens the URL and polls explicitly.'
        ...
    async def authorization(self, id: str, *, request_timeout: float | None=None) -> models.AuthorizationTransaction:
        ...
    async def cancel_authorization(self, id: str, *, request_timeout: float | None=None) -> models.AuthorizationTransaction:
        ...
    async def get(self, id: str, *, request_timeout: float | None=None) -> models.ConnectionSummary:
        ...
    async def disconnect(self, id: str, *, request_timeout: float | None=None) -> models.DisconnectResponse:
        'Fence grants; poll explicitly to confirm provider retirement.'
        ...

class CredentialGrants():
    def __init__(self, vm: VM) -> None:
        ...
    async def list(self, *, request_timeout: float | None=None) -> models.SessionGrantListResponse:
        ...
    async def create(self, request: models.CreateSessionGrantRequest, *, request_timeout: float | None=None) -> models.SessionGrantSummary:
        'Explicit approval for this owner; never reconnect or replay a mutation.'
        ...
    async def revoke(self, grant_id: str, *, request_timeout: float | None=None) -> models.RevokeSessionGrantResponse:
        ...
```

## Files, Stats

```python
class Files(Resource):
    "Paths are the guest's: `/root/x` in a VM, `/workspace/x` in its container,\nor `x` relative to the workspace. `exact=True` takes a path literally,\nrelative to the workspace root, even when it is absolute."
    async def read(self, path: str, *, exact: bool=False) -> bytes:
        ...
    async def write(self, path: str, data: bytes, *, exact: bool=False) -> models.UploadResponse:
        ...
    async def list(self, path: str='', *, depth: int | None=None, exact: bool=False) -> models.FileListResponse:
        'An empty `path` lists the workspace root.'
        ...

class Stats(Resource):
    async def summary(self) -> models.VmStatsSummaryResponse:
        ...
    async def details(self) -> models.VmStatsDetailResponse:
        ...
```
